title: Round 9 — 40b05a74 / f2618e30: A/B of this head's fixes on the real stack
subtitle: Old arm = 67c908ea build (bundle + Broker jar kept aside); new arm = 40b05a74, then every row rechecked on f2618e30 (merge of main incl. #12894); MySQL 8.4.11.
lines: ## R4-9 (my round-8 trap): lone surrogate in a resource URI, prompt name, argument key or argument value
-- 67c908ea (value and key, round 8): Broker 400 -> outcome_unknown -> Session blocked, detach 503, lease held
++ 40b05a74: all four -> 400 invalid_mcp_operation, 0 Broker requests; next read settles, detach 204, lease 0
## Refresh replacement cancelled (doudouOUC P1): the tool list really changes; the replacement's acquire is held
-- 67c908ea: turn cancelled at 2.0 s, but the replacement mcp-configure is still sent at 4.9 s
-- 67c908ea: a detach during the hold answers 204 (released before the acquisition finished)
++ 40b05a74: no configure after the cancel; detach during the hold 503 (not released); next turn OK
++ held after dispatch_started instead: the configure is sent once and not resent (both heads)
## R5-1 + R5-4: explicit replacement admitted during a turn; the old stdio connection takes > 5 s to retire
-- 67c908ea: turn ends with no terminal event and stays blocked; replacement 503 (outcome_unknown); next prompt 409
++ 40b05a74: turn_error, not latched; replacement settles at 6.4 s; the next turn runs on the new server
## R5-3: raw notifications named toString, __proto__, constructor, hasOwnProperty, valueOf
-- 67c908ea (toString, __proto__, hasOwnProperty): each triggers a replacement (config revision 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4)
++ 40b05a74: ignored; no configuration, catalog unchanged
## Approval path from main: allow at 310 s, after the 300 s MCP grant lease
++ the tool runs once with the original arguments, end_turn, no Broker errors, detach 204 (2 s control: same)
## Mutants on this head's changes: 9 of 10 killed; K2 survives (the same check repeats after dispatch)

notes.text: The R4-9 trap, the refresh-cancellation P1, R5-1, R5-3 and the R5-4 configuration path are fixed on the real stack, each against the previous head.

title: Round 9 — release paths that still never finish, Flyway and regression (40b05a74 and f2618e30)
subtitle: Same rig and arms. A stuck release keeps the Session undetachable and the Workspace lease held.
lines: ## R5-2, Session with one pinned server: the first mcp-release never reaches the Runtime (Broker proxy 503)
!! detach 1: 503. detach 2: Broker tool-session release 409 "still owns unfinished work"
!!    then status and acquire 409 runtime_session_not_ready; the release is never re-sent; lease held (both heads)
++ two pinned servers: detach 2 re-sends the releases -> 204, lease 0 (67c908ea: stuck)
== close() calls broker.release() first when every configuration is releasing; after its 409 the runtime Session is not ready
## A release that timed out: a stdio server whose stdout outlives it (a grandchild keeps the pipe for ~45 s)
++ one pinned server: detach 503 while the pipe is open, 204 at 52 s (both heads)
!! two pinned servers (both heads), or a server replaced on 40b05a74: detach 503 for 98 s / 134 s, lease held
!!    40b05a74 re-sends mcp-release with the same id and gets the stored outcome_unknown/managed_mcp_drain_unknown
## Flyway: #12894 has landed on main
++ f2618e30 carries V20-V22 (publication) and V23 (MCP); an empty database migrates to 1..23 and starts
== on 40b05a74, applying this PR first and #12894 later failed validation; that order can no longer happen
## Regression: the rounds 1-8 set holds on 40b05a74; the key subset reran on f2618e30 with identical results
== N1 638 s; F1; R3-11 is an accepted limitation per the maintainer approval

notes.text: Before merge: fix R5-2 for the one-server Session (the common shape) or accept it alongside R3-11. The timed-out release is not new, but the R5-2 retry does not cover it. Both are unchanged on f2618e30.
